hints.appointments: The Appointments screen: booking, confirming and cancelling, marking a patient arrived, and the bookings the public page sends in.

hints.clinic: The Clinic details screen: the name, the logo, the location and the working hours.
hints.clinic-closures: Closures in the clinic details: the holidays the whole clinic is shut for.
hints.doctors: The Doctors screen: adding a doctor and editing their details, their weekly hours and their time off. A doctor may only change their own; an administrator may change any doctor’s.
hints.inventory: The Inventory screen: the items, buying, using up and stock takes, and the movements behind the count.
hints.lab-orders: The Orders tab of the Labs screen: sending work out and following it through to fitting. Each stage is its own permission.

hints.notes: The dashboard notes: what the staff leave each other. Only the person who wrote a note may change it.

hints.payments: The Account tab of a patient’s file: taking a payment, printing the receipt, and reversing one entered by mistake.
hints.performed-procedures: Treatments in a patient’s file: recording one against a tooth or a visit, and editing it.
hints.permissions: This screen: who may read what each role is allowed to do, and who may change it. The administrator’s own are not among what can be changed.
hints.prescriptions: Prescriptions in a patient’s file: writing, editing and deleting them.
hints.procedure-catalog: The price list: what the clinic offers and what each procedure is charged at.
hints.suppliers: The Suppliers tab of the Inventory screen: who the clinic buys from, and their statement.
hints.treatment-plans: The Treatment plans tab of a patient’s file: building a plan and its items, and turning an item into a treatment done.
hints.users: The Users screen: staff accounts, and sending an activation invitation or a password reset link.
hints.visits: The Visits tab of a patient’s file: recording a visit and what happened in it.
hints.waiting-list: The waiting list inside the Appointments screen: who is waiting for a free slot, calling them, and turning an entry into an appointment.
hints.translations: The Interface Text screen: changing the wording the clinic sees, and restoring the original.
hints.payroll: The Payroll screen: staff salaries, the monthly payroll, paying a salary and closing a month.
